name: Oil pan gasket / sealant
what: The oil pan seal closes the joint between the sump and crankcase.
why: It helps prevent engine oil from leaking at the pan flange.
where: It sits between the oil pan flange and the bottom of the block.
installationReason: Apply the sealing bead to the clean pan rail after the pickup is in place and before fitting the oil pan.
